notes.note: vite-offline-shell.ts delta: a warm module outside the build root is skipped instead of failing the build, so a fixture build that reuses the app configuration under another root still builds; the app build (root src-ui) still warms the Chat dock, transcript and composer graphs best-effort, skipped under Save-Data, and still fails when a named module inside the root is missing. The required install set, warm set, worker update and fallback claims here remain accurate.
